title: Newsletter Management
description: Learn how to manage newsletter subscribers, send email campaigns, and build your email marketing list.
content:
Newsletter Management

Build and manage your email list to stay in touch with customers, promote products, and drive sales through email marketing.

Newsletter Subscribers

Manage your subscriber list:

  • View all subscribers
  • Add subscribers manually
  • Import subscribers from CSV
  • Export subscriber list
  • Remove subscribers
  • View subscriber details

Subscriber Collection

Collect subscribers through:

  • Newsletter signup form on store
  • Checkout opt-in
  • Account registration
  • Manual addition
  • Import from other sources

Email Campaigns

Send email campaigns to subscribers:

  • Product announcements
  • Sales and promotions
  • Newsletters
  • Abandoned cart emails
  • Order updates
  • Seasonal campaigns

Email Templates

Create and use email templates:

  • Newsletter template
  • Promotional template
  • Product announcement template
  • Custom templates
  • Branded designs

Segmentation

Segment your subscribers:

  • By purchase history
  • By interests
  • By location
  • By engagement level
  • Custom segments

Automation

Automate email campaigns:

  • Welcome emails
  • Abandoned cart reminders
  • Order confirmations
  • Shipping notifications
  • Post-purchase follow-ups

Compliance

Ensure email compliance:

  • GDPR compliance
  • CAN-SPAM compliance
  • Unsubscribe options
  • Privacy policy
  • Consent management

Analytics

Track newsletter performance:

  • Open rates
  • Click-through rates
  • Conversion rates
  • Unsubscribe rates
  • Subscriber growth

Best Practices

  • Send valuable content
  • Don't spam subscribers
  • Use clear subject lines
  • Make emails mobile-friendly
  • Include unsubscribe option
  • Segment your audience
  • Test before sending
  • Monitor performance

  • Promotions & Discounts
